SEARCH
Package de.nexus.antixray.api

Interface StoredMiningStats

public interface StoredMiningStats
What NexusAntiXRay has stored for one player across server restarts, as an immutable snapshot loaded by NexusAntiXRayApi.loadStats(java.util.UUID).

The numbers are the totals over everything the x-ray detection has counted for the player since the record was created, including what has been counted since the last write to disk. They are counted the same way as the totals of MiningStats: mined blocks are the blocks listed under xray-detection.mined-blocks, bait veins are the fake ore veins of the types listed under xray-detection.bait-ores the player dug into. The detection window is not part of this object; it only exists in memory, see MiningStats.

A record is created with the first block that counts for a player, not when the player joins. It is removed again when the player has not been seen for xray-detection.storage.retention-days days; after that NexusAntiXRayApi.loadStats(java.util.UUID) completes with null for this player until something is counted again, and the totals start at zero.

The object never changes after it was created and may be passed to any thread. NexusAntiXRay implements this interface; later versions of the API may add methods.

Since:
1.0.0

    • getRate

      double getRate()
      Bait veins per 100 mined blocks over the totals (getBaitVeins() and getMinedBlocks()); with fewer than one mined block it is calculated as if one block had been mined.

      Alerts are not decided on this value but on the rate within the detection window (MiningStats.getWindowRate()). Over months of ordinary mining the overall rate of a player who used x-ray for one evening looks harmless.

      Returns:
      the overall rate, 0 or more
      Since:
      1.0.0
